items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: Johnny Detroit and Paul and all of them, they made a record with OK then. I do remember that. I think Johnny made Tulane Swing.

ctx.x: And Johnny Cotrera, I doubt if you know him, he's a trumpet.
Oh. Yeah. He did. I knew Johnny. He was one of them. Handsome Johnny?
